title: Key word transformations (C2) 1
summary_es: Seis frases: inversión negativa, expresiones idiomáticas, «but for», pasiva con infinitivo perfecto y deducción.

items.original: The minister refused to comment on the rumours under any circumstances.
items.explanation_es: «On no account» al principio obliga a la inversión: auxiliar + sujeto, como en una pregunta.

items.original: I never imagined for a moment that she would resign.
items.explanation_es: «It never crossed my mind that…» = ni se me pasó por la cabeza que…

items.original: If the weather hadn't been so bad, the festival would have been a success.
items.before: The festival would have been a success
items.explanation_es: «But for» + nombre = de no haber sido por. Sustituye a toda la oración con if.

items.original: People say he was a brilliant pianist in his youth.
items.after: a brilliant pianist in his youth.
items.explanation_es: «Be reputed to» + infinitivo perfecto, porque se refiere a un tiempo anterior.

items.original: I'm sure it wasn't easy for her to admit she was wrong.
items.after: for her to admit she was wrong.
items.explanation_es: Deducción negativa sobre el pasado: can't + have + participio.

items.original: The new law will have little effect on small businesses.
items.explanation_es: «Make little difference to» = afectar poco a. Con difference la preposición es to, no on.
